title: Hannah's Prayer for a Son
description: The barren Hannah prays earnestly to the Lord in Shiloh and promises to dedicate her child to God's service. The priest Eli first thinks she is drunk, but blesses her. God hears her prayer, and she gives birth to Samuel, whom she later entrusts to the Lord.

versions.title: Hannah's Prayer for a Son
versions.description: The barren Hannah prays earnestly to God in the house of the Lord in Shiloh and promises to dedicate her child to the Lord's service. God hears her prayer, and she gives birth to her son Samuel, whom she entrusts to the Lord.
versions.reason: [major] category: The category 'Judges' does not fit well. 1 Samuel marks the transition from the period of the judges to the monarchy, and Samuel himself is regarded as the last judge/first prophet. 'The Monarchy' is more appropriate since 1 Samuel belongs to that period.; [minor] slug: The slug 'hannah-ber-om-en-sonn' has a double-h in Hannah, but the Norwegian form is 'Hanna'. It should be 'hanna-ber-om-en-sonn'.
